para.text: The problem is that the object that sets the value of the RmaMf6Completed_Kx_1 data set only sets the values of cells intersected by the object. The points in that object were located at the centers of the previous quadtree refined grid. Fixing this requires two changes. First the data set need to have a suitable interpolator specified. Second, the object that sets the values of RmaMf6Completed_Kx_1 needs to set values by interpolation.
